# Municipal Ordinance No. KauBayansaLaangGgulinBlg01S199, Series of 1996

**Kau. Bayan sa Laang Ggulin Blg. 01**

## Summary

Supplemental Budget Ordinance (Kautusang Bayan sa Laang-Gugulin) No. 01, Series of [[1996]], enacted by the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] of [[Municipality of Pitogo|Pitogo]], Quezon on November 11, 1996. This ordinance appropriates a supplemental budget totaling approximately P270,598,830.28 (as stated in the document), sourced from the balance of Forty-Five Million Pesos (P45,000,000) Internal Revenue Allotment and other local revenues, for the operations and services of the municipal government for fiscal year [[1997]].

## Key Provisions

- **Section 1.** From the estimated balance of Forty-Five Million Pesos, less amounts for personal services (salaries), MOOE, and other obligations, the remaining balance of Seven Hundred Forty Pesos and Five Centavos and Fifty-Seven Thousand Eight Hundred Thirty Centavos (P270,598,830.28) is appropriated for municipal government operations for fiscal year [[1997]], pursuant to [[Sec-305-RA7160|Section 305]], Republic Act No. 7160.
- **Section 2.** Funds are also allocated for the Human Resource Management Officer III position and for the Utility Worker I in the Office of the [[Sangguniang Bayan]], and for the Mayor's office staff for long and faithful service.
- **Section 3.** The Supplemental Budget with details and supporting schedules for fiscal year [[1997]] is attached as Annex "A."
- **Section 4.** This ordinance on Supplemental Budget (Laang-Gugulin Blg. 01) takes effect on January 1, 1997.
- **Section 5.** Approved on November 11, 1996 at Pitogo, Quezon.

**Effectivity:** January 1, 1997

## Entities

- [[Sangguniang Bayan]] — enacted the ordinance
- [[Municipality of Pitogo]] — local government unit
- [[Domingo L. Tan]] — Vice Mayor / Presiding Officer (Pangandalawang Punong Bayan)
- [[Rafael C. Glinoga]] — Municipal Mayor (approved)
- [[Socrates B. Boruel]] — Secretary to the Sangguniang Bayan

## Legal Basis (RA 7160 Sections)

- [[RA-7160|Republic Act No. 7160]] (Local Government Code of 1991)
  - [[Sec-16-RA7160|Section 16]] — General welfare clause
  - [[Sec-447-RA7160|Section 447]] — Powers of the Sangguniang Bayan

## Timeline

- Enacted: November 11, [[1996]]
- Effectivity: January 1, [[1997]]
